arness plugin: downscale images on Claude requests so many-image requests never hit the 2000px limit
Stops this Claude error in DeepSeek Harness:

**Cause.** Anthropic allows up to 8000px per side, but a request carrying
more than 20 images is cap

ped at 2000px per side. DSH normalizes attachments
to a 2048×2048 *pixel budget* (8192px long edge),

so a phone screenshot such as
1080×2400 is stored as-is. Once a session's history holds more than 2

**Fix.** This host plugin wraps `fetch` for `api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`
requests and downscales

any inline base64 image whose longer side exceeds
`maxDimension` (default 2000). The results are det

erministic and cached by
content hash, so re-sent history stays byte-identical and the prompt cache

and cached by
content hash, so re-sent history stays byte-identical and the prompt cache
still hits.

Limitation: requests routed through a subscriptions-plugin HTTP proxy use
undici's own fetch and byp

ass the wrapper. No proxy is configured on this
machine.
